verdict.rationale: v0's Platform API docs say it offers programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities: code generation, chat, project management, deployment, GitHub imports, export and custom chat UIs. The official vercel/v0-sdk adds working code (`v0.chats.create`), streaming helpers and API-key/OIDC authentication. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of driving v0 through the API.
